title: Idioms That Don’t Seem Like Idioms
synopsis: Learn about some surprising Chinese idioms.

fullText.simplified:
不像成语的成语

    有的成语一看就是成语，比如“一箭双雕”、“百里挑一”等。还有些成语看起来特别不像成语，让人压根就不觉得是成语。
    有一个成语是“加减乘除”。曾经在一个节目里，有一个环节是从一堆词语里挑出不是成语的词。节目的主持人是北京大学毕业的。很多人认为北京大学是中国最好的大学，从那里毕业的人说的话肯定不会错。但是连主持人都说如果“加减乘除”是成语的话，他就吃掉手里的卡片。结果却令人大跌眼镜。因为“加减乘除”确实是成语。它的意思本指算术中四种基本运算法则，比喻心里盘算，还可以比喻事物的变化消长。
    还有一个容易误解的成语是“冬日可爱”。表面上看，这个成语说的好像是冬天很可爱。其实不然。“冬日可爱”的意思是如同冬天里的太阳那样使人感到温暖、亲切，比喻人态度温和慈爱，使人愿意接近。这个成语出自《左传·文公七年》：“赵衰，冬日之日也；赵盾，夏日之日也。”后来魏晋时期的军事家杜预在注解《左传》时写道：“冬日可爱，夏日可畏。”
    赵盾是赵衰的儿子，是春秋时期的政治家。他在晋国任职期间，权势极大，甚至削弱了晋国国君的权力。后来在晋国国君死后，赵盾在拥立谁为新国君的问题上与晋国大夫贾季争执不下。后来，有人问贾季：“赵盾与他的父亲赵衰相比，哪一个更贤明？”贾季打了个比方说：“赵衰是冬日太阳，赵盾是夏日太阳。”意思是，赵衰好像冬天的太阳，使人感到温暖、亲切，人们愿意接近。赵盾心狠手辣，令人感到恐怖，就像夏天毒辣的太阳。所以后来人们就用“冬日可爱”来形容态度温和亲切的人，用“夏日可畏”来形容严厉、狠辣，令人敬畏的人。
    这些不像成语的成语，你学会了吗？
fullText.traditional:
不像成語的成語

    有的成語一看就是成語，比如“一箭雙鵰”、“百裡挑一”等。還有些成語看起來特別不像成語，讓人壓根就不覺得是成語。
    有一個成語是“加減乘除”。曾經在一個節目裡，有一個環節是從一堆詞語裡挑出不是成語的詞。節目的主持人是北京大學畢業的。很多人認為北京大學是中國最好的大學，從那裡畢業的人說的話肯定不會錯。但是連主持人都說如果“加減乘除”是成語的話，他就吃掉手裡的卡片。結果卻令人大跌眼鏡。因為“加減乘除”確實是成語。它的意思本指算術中四種基本運算法則，比喻心裡盤算，還可以比喻事物的變化消長。
    還有一個容易誤解的成語是“冬日可愛”。表面上看，這個成語說的好像是冬天很可愛。其實不然。“冬日可愛”的意思是如同冬天裡的太陽那樣使人感到溫暖、親切，比喻人態度溫和慈愛，使人願意接近。這個成語出自《左傳·文公七年》：“趙衰，冬日之日也；趙盾，夏日之日也。”後來魏晉時期的軍事家杜預在註解《左傳》時寫道：“冬日可愛，夏日可畏。”
    趙盾是趙衰的兒子，是春秋時期的政治家。他在晉國任職期間，權勢極大，甚至削弱了晉國國君的權力。後來在晉國國君死後，趙盾在擁立誰為新國君的問題上與晉國大夫賈季爭執不下。後來，有人問賈季：“趙盾與他的父親趙衰相比，哪一個更賢明？”賈季打了個比方說：“趙衰是冬日太陽，趙盾是夏日太陽。”意思是，趙衰好像冬天的太陽，使人感到溫暖、親切，人們願意接近。趙盾心狠手辣，令人感到恐怖，就像夏天毒辣的太陽。所以後來人們就用“冬日可愛”來形容態度溫和親切的人，用“夏日可畏”來形容嚴厲、狠辣，令人敬畏的人。
    這些不像成語的成語，你學會了嗎？

sentences.english: .. such as “killing two birds with one stone”, or “cream of the crop”, etc.
There are other Chinese idioms that don’t seem like idioms, leading people to believe that they aren’t idioms at all.

sentences.traditional: 有一個成語是“加減乘除”。

sentences.traditional: 曾經在一個節目裡，有一個環節是從一堆詞語裡挑出不是成語的詞。
sentences.pinyin: céng jīng zài yí ge jié mù lǐ yǒu yí ge huán jié shì cóng yì duī cí yǔ lǐ tiāo chū bú shì chéng yǔ de cí
sentences.english: One such idiom is “addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division”.

sentences.simplified: 节目的主持人是北京大学毕业的。
sentences.traditional: 節目的主持人是北京大學畢業的。
sentences.pinyin: jié mù de zhǔ chí rén shì běi jīng dà xué bì yè de
sentences.english: Once, on a TV show, there was a segment that consisted of picking out non-idiom phrases among a bunch of phrases.

sentences.simplified: 很多人认为北京大学是中国最好的大学，从那里毕业的人说的话肯定不会错。
sentences.traditional: 很多人認為北京大學是中國最好的大學，從那裡畢業的人說的話肯定不會錯。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén rèn wéi běi jīng dà xué shì zhōng guó zuì hǎo de dà xué cóng nà lǐ bì yè de rén shuō de huà kěn dìng bú huì cuò
sentences.english: The host of the show was a Peking University graduate.

sentences.simplified: 但是连主持人都说如果“加减乘除”是成语的话，
sentences.traditional: 但是連主持人都說如果“加減乘除”是成語的話，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì lián zhǔ chí rén dōu shuō rú guǒ jiā jiǎn chéng chú shì chéng yǔ de huà
sentences.english: Many people consider Peking University to be China’s top university, so people who graduate from there can’t be wrong.

sentences.simplified: 他就吃掉手里的卡片。
sentences.traditional: 他就吃掉手裡的卡片。
sentences.pinyin: tā jiù chī diào shǒu lǐ de kǎ piàn
sentences.english: But, even the host said if “addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division” is an idiom, ..

sentences.simplified: 结果却令人大跌眼镜。因为“加减乘除”确实是成语。
sentences.traditional: 結果卻令人大跌眼鏡。因為“加減乘除”確實是成語。

sentences.english: .. he would eat the cue cards in his hand.

sentences.simplified: 它的意思本指算术中四种基本运算法则，
sentences.traditional: 它的意思本指算術中四種基本運算法則，
sentences.pinyin: tā de yì si běn zhǐ suàn shù zhōng sì zhǒng jī běn yùn suàn fǎ zé
sentences.english: The result, however, was astounding, because ”addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division” is indeed an idiom.

sentences.simplified: 比喻心里盘算，
sentences.traditional: 比喻心裡盤算，
sentences.pinyin: bǐ yù xīn li pán suàn
sentences.english: Its meaning originally refers to the four basic arithmetic operations, ..

sentences.simplified: 还可以比喻事物的变化消长。
sentences.traditional: 還可以比喻事物的變化消長。
sentences.pinyin: hái kě yǐ bǐ yù shì wù de biàn huà xiāo zhǎng
sentences.english: .. and is an analogy for calculating something in one’s mind.
It can also be used as an analogy for the ebb and flow of things.

sentences.simplified: 还有一个容易误解的成语是“冬日可爱”。
sentences.traditional: 還有一個容易誤解的成語是“冬日可愛”。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu yí ge róng yì wù jiě de chéng yǔ shì dōng rì kě ài

sentences.simplified: 表面上看，这个成语说的好像是冬天很可爱。其实不然。
sentences.traditional: 表面上看，這個成語說的好像是冬天很可愛。其實不然。
sentences.pinyin: biǎo miàn shang kàn zhè ge chéng yǔ shuō de hǎo xiàng shì dōng tiān hěn kě ài qí shí bù rán
sentences.english: Another idiom that is easily misunderstood is “the lovely sun in winter”.

sentences.simplified: “冬日可爱”的意思是如同冬天里的太阳那样使人感到温暖、亲切，
sentences.traditional: “冬日可愛”的意思是如同冬天裡的太陽那樣使人感到溫暖、親切，
sentences.pinyin: dōng rì kě ài de yì si shì rú tóng dōng tiān lǐ de tài yáng nà yàng shǐ rén gǎn dào wēn nuǎn qīn qiè
sentences.english: On the surface, this idiom appears to say that winter is cute. But actually, this is not so.

sentences.simplified: 比喻人态度温和慈爱，使人愿意接近。
sentences.traditional: 比喻人態度溫和慈愛，使人願意接近。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ yù rén tài du wēn hé cí ài shǐ rén yuàn yì jiē jìn
sentences.english: Just as the sun brings feelings of warmth and closeness in winter, “the lovely sun in winter” ..

sentences.simplified: 这个成语出自《左传·文公七年》：
sentences.traditional: 這個成語出自《左傳·文公七年》：
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge chéng yǔ chū zì zuǒ zhuàn wén gōng qī nián
sentences.english: .. is an analogy for people with a warm and loving manner, people that others want to grow closer to.

sentences.simplified: “赵衰，冬日之日也；赵盾，夏日之日也。”
sentences.traditional: “趙衰，冬日之日也；趙盾，夏日之日也。”
sentences.pinyin: zhào cuī dōng rì zhī rì yě zhào dùn xià rì zhī rì yě
sentences.english: This idiom comes from “The Tradition of Zuo, Duke Wen Year Seven”:

sentences.simplified: 后来魏晋时期的军事家杜预在注解《左传》时写道：
sentences.traditional: 後來魏晉時期的軍事家杜預在註解《左傳》時寫道：
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái wèi jìn shí qī de jūn shì jiā dù yù zài zhù jiě zuǒ zhuàn shí xiě dào
sentences.english: “Zhao Cui is like the sun on a winter day, and Zhao Dun is like the sun on a summer day.”

sentences.simplified: “冬日可爱，夏日可畏。”
sentences.traditional: “冬日可愛，夏日可畏。”
sentences.pinyin: dōng rì kě ài xià rì kě wèi
sentences.english: Later, Du Yu, a military strategist from the Wei and Jin dynasties, wrote in his commentary on the “The Tradition of Zuo”:
“The winter sun is to be loved, and the summer sun is to be feared.”

sentences.simplified: 赵盾是赵衰的儿子，是春秋时期的政治家。
sentences.traditional: 趙盾是趙衰的兒子，是春秋時期的政治家。
sentences.pinyin: zhào dùn shì zhào cuī de ér zi shì chūn qiū shí qī de zhèng zhì jiā

sentences.simplified: 他在晋国任职期间，权势极大，甚至削弱了晋国国君的权力。
sentences.traditional: 他在晉國任職期間，權勢極大，甚至削弱了晉國國君的權力。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài jìn guó rèn zhí qī jiān quán shì jí dà shèn zhì xuē ruò le jìn guó guó jūn de quán lì
sentences.english: Zhao Dun was Zhao Cui’s son, and was a politician during the Spring and Autumn period.

sentences.simplified: 后来在晋国国君死后，
sentences.traditional: 後來在晉國國君死後，
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái zài jìn guó guó jūn sǐ hòu
sentences.english: When he held office during the Jin dynasty, he had great power, that weakened even the power of the Jin Dynasty monarch.

sentences.simplified: 赵盾在拥立谁为新国君的问题上与晋国大夫贾季争执不下。
sentences.traditional: 趙盾在擁立誰為新國君的問題上與晉國大夫賈季爭執不下。
sentences.pinyin: zhào dùn zài yōng lì shéi wéi xīn guó jūn de wèn tí shang yǔ jìn guó dà fū jiǎ jì zhēng zhí bú xià
sentences.english: Later, after the Jin Dynasty monarch passed away, ..

sentences.simplified: 后来，有人问贾季：“赵盾与他的父亲赵衰相比，哪一个更贤明？”
sentences.traditional: 後來，有人問賈季：“趙盾與他的父親趙衰相比，哪一個更賢明？”
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái yǒu rén wèn jiǎ jì zhào dùn yǔ tā de fù qīn zhào cuī xiāng bǐ nǎ yí ge gèng xián míng
sentences.english: .. Zhao Dun and Jin Dynasty senior official Jia Ji were in an endless conflict over who should be enthroned as the new monarch.

sentences.simplified: 贾季打了个比方说：“赵衰是冬日太阳，赵盾是夏日太阳。”
sentences.traditional: 賈季打了個比方說：“趙衰是冬日太陽，趙盾是夏日太陽。”
sentences.pinyin: jiǎ jì dǎ le ge bǐ fang shuō zhào cuī shì dōng rì tài yáng zhào dùn shì xià rì tài yáng
sentences.english: Later, someone asked Jia Ji, “Comparing Zhao Dun and his father Zhao Cui, who is wiser and more capable?”

sentences.simplified: 意思是，赵衰好像冬天的太阳，使人感到温暖、亲切，
sentences.traditional: 意思是，趙衰好像冬天的太陽，使人感到溫暖、親切，
sentences.pinyin: yì si shì zhào cuī hǎo xiàng dōng tiān de tài yáng shǐ rén gǎn dào wēn nuǎn qīn qiè
sentences.english: Jia Ji made an analogy, “Zhao Cui is the winter sun, and Zhao Dun is the summer sun.”

sentences.simplified: 人们愿意接近。
sentences.traditional: 人們願意接近。
sentences.pinyin: rén men yuàn yì jiē jìn
sentences.english: This means that Zhao Cui is like the sun during winter, bringing feelings of warmth and intimacy, ..

sentences.simplified: 赵盾心狠手辣，令人感到恐怖，就像夏天毒辣的太阳。
sentences.traditional: 趙盾心狠手辣，令人感到恐怖，就像夏天毒辣的太陽。
sentences.pinyin: zhào dùn xīn hěn shǒu là lìng rén gǎn dào kǒng bù jiù xiàng xià tiān dú là de tài yáng
sentences.english: .. so people wish to get closer.

sentences.simplified: 所以后来人们就用“冬日可爱”来形容态度温和亲切的人，
sentences.traditional: 所以後來人們就用“冬日可愛”來形容態度溫和親切的人，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ hòu lái rén men jiù yòng dōng rì kě ài lái xíng róng tài du wēn hé qīn qiè de rén
sentences.english: Zhao Dun was cruel and merciless, instilling fear in others, like the vicious sun in summer.

sentences.simplified: 用“夏日可畏”来形容严厉、狠辣，令人敬畏的人。
sentences.traditional: 用“夏日可畏”來形容嚴厲、狠辣，令人敬畏的人。
sentences.pinyin: yòng xià rì kě wèi lái xíng róng yán lì hěn là lìng rén jìng wèi de rén
sentences.english: Hence, people later used “winter sun” to describe people who are gentle and amiable.
They used “summer sun” to describe people who are severe, cruel, and awe-inspiring.

raw.synopsis: Learn about some surprising Chinese idioms.
sentence_translations: Chinese Idioms That Don’t Seem Like Idioms
Some Chinese idioms, you’ll know right away that they are idioms, ..
.. such as “killing two birds with one stone”, or “cream of the crop”, etc.
There are other Chinese idioms that don’t seem like idioms, leading people to believe that they aren’t idioms at all.
One such idiom is “addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division”.
Once, on a TV show, there was a segment that consisted of picking out non-idiom phrases among a bunch of phrases.
The host of the show was a Peking University graduate.
Many people consider Peking University to be China’s top university, so people who graduate from there can’t be wrong.
But, even the host said if “addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division” is an idiom, ..
.. he would eat the cue cards in his hand.
The result, however, was astounding, because ”addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division” is indeed an idiom.
Its meaning originally refers to the four basic arithmetic operations, ..
.. and is an analogy for calculating something in one’s mind.
It can also be used as an analogy for the ebb and flow of things.
Another idiom that is easily misunderstood is “the lovely sun in winter”.
On the surface, this idiom appears to say that winter is cute. But actually, this is not so.
Just as the sun brings feelings of warmth and closeness in winter, “the lovely sun in winter” ..
.. is an analogy for people with a warm and loving manner, people that others want to grow closer to.
This idiom comes from “The Tradition of Zuo, Duke Wen Year Seven”:
“Zhao Cui is like the sun on a winter day, and Zhao Dun is like the sun on a summer day.”
Later, Du Yu, a military strategist from the Wei and Jin dynasties, wrote in his commentary on the “The Tradition of Zuo”:
“The winter sun is to be loved, and the summer sun is to be feared.”
Zhao Dun was Zhao Cui’s son, and was a politician during the Spring and Autumn period.
When he held office during the Jin dynasty, he had great power, that weakened even the power of the Jin Dynasty monarch.
Later, after the Jin Dynasty monarch passed away, ..
.. Zhao Dun and Jin Dynasty senior official Jia Ji were in an endless conflict over who should be enthroned as the new monarch.
Later, someone asked Jia Ji, “Comparing Zhao Dun and his father Zhao Cui, who is wiser and more capable?”
Jia Ji made an analogy, “Zhao Cui is the winter sun, and Zhao Dun is the summer sun.”
This means that Zhao Cui is like the sun during winter, bringing feelings of warmth and intimacy, ..
.. so people wish to get closer.
Zhao Dun was cruel and merciless, instilling fear in others, like the vicious sun in summer.
Hence, people later used “winter sun” to describe people who are gentle and amiable.
They used “summer sun” to describe people who are severe, cruel, and awe-inspiring.
These Chinese idioms that don’t appear to be idioms – have you mastered them?
